visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight brown hair wears a light blue camisole with small white bows. She stands in a narrow residential hallway, clapping her hands and smiling widely toward the lens. Beside her, a red Chinese New Year banner and a fire extinguisher are visible on the plain wall. (2) The camera transitions to the interior of an older, cluttered home. Large wooden cabinets filled with miscellaneous items, a round dining table with a lazy susan, and traditional red decorative ornaments are featured. The lighting is slightly dim compared to the professional lighting in the introduction. (3) Two women are shown against a plain neutral-tiled wall. The older woman has short curly hair and glasses, wearing a striped shirt. The younger woman now wears a white off-shoulder ruffled top. They gesture toward each other and smile warmly at the camera. (4) The scene shifts to a dark, unlit apartment interior. The older woman walks away from the camera toward a living area, her hand raised as if searching for a switch. The silhouette of modern furniture like a dining table and chairs is barely visible. (5) A montage of a bright, modernly designed apartment follows. It features a neutral cream-style palette, a large light-grey sofa, a round marble coffee table, and a minimalist study desk with a sleek chair. Panning shots emphasize the smooth cabinet surfaces and warm recessed lighting. (6) The two women are seated on a white sofa in the new apartment. The older woman holds a grey throw pillow while speaking, and the younger woman sits closely beside her, listening attentively. Large floor-to-ceiling windows behind them reveal a high-rise urban city view.
